title: Plakar Backblaze B2 Storage Connector Config

location.description: B2 location URI. Native (preferred): b2://<bucket>/<optional-prefix>, e.g. b2://mybucket/myprefix or b2://mybucket. Legacy/compatible: b2://<endpoint>/<bucket>/<optional-prefix>, e.g. b2://s3.us-west-004.backblazeb2.com/mybucket
